lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co8Ni2O16 (reduced formula Co4NiO8) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 26 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Co, Ni, and O centers: Co and Ni each have six O neighbors, while O is surrounded by three Co and three Ni neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner-sharing between CoO6 and NiO6 octahedra, as well as edge-sharing between CoO6 octahedra and between O-centered octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
